title: Waterfront trail information board
slide_intent: Place geographic guidance in the environment because people need orientation at the point of travel.
strategic_value: The yellow wave header and map arrangement can connect Helsinki waterfront guidance to the city identity.
demonstration: This webpage photograph shows a long waterfront information board with multilingual text, a yellow wave-edged header and two blue maps, set against a harbor.
practical_value: Compare map prominence and multilingual explanation at a real outdoor information point.
